title: Google Plans Workspace MCP Servers for AI Agents, Gmail Send Unsupported
summary: Google plans to make AI agents use its MCP servers to access Workspace, according to TechStackUps, but the Gmail server cannot send email. The report did not specify when the servers will be available or whether the Gmail sending restriction is permanent.
